examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The band as the site places it: the region overline, the headline and lead over the world map, four claim chips, and a floor of four client outcomes with their marks. Edit the props in the Controls panel — a band with no title renders nothing at all.

examples.name: Types
examples.summary: Both floors stacked: the `outcomes` kind closes the band with four client quotes, the `benefits` kind with three icon-led topics — each floor sets its columns from its entry count. The map, title, lead and claims above are the same in both.

examples.name: Columns
examples.summary: The floor takes one column per entry, two at least and four at most, on either kind: two, three and four `outcomes`, then two, three and four `benefits`. No entry count leaves an empty cell in the row.

site.name: ClientQuotes
site.summary: Four client outcomes on the floor, each a quote with its figure highlighted and signed by the client logo; Dafiti and Fourbank are drawn in one ink that follows the theme.

site.name: Benefits
site.summary: Three network benefits on the floor, each an icon, a title and one sentence.
